text:
Predicates:
National(x, y) ::: x is a y-national.
BasketballPlayer(x) ::: x is a professional basketball player.
CanDoJumpShot(x) ::: x can do jump shots.
LeapsStraightIntoAir(x) ::: x leaps straight into the air.
ActivatesLegMuscles(x) ::: x activates their leg muscles.
Yuri ::: the individual named Yuri.

Premises:
∃x (BasketballPlayer(x) ∧ ¬National(x, american)) ::: Some professional basketball players are not American nationals.
∀x (BasketballPlayer(x) → CanDoJumpShot(x)) ::: All professional basketball players can do jump shots.
∀x (CanDoJumpShot(x) → LeapsStraightIntoAir(x)) ::: If someone can do jump shots, they leap straight into the air.
∀x (LeapsStraightIntoAir(x) → ActivatesLegMuscles(x)) ::: If someone leaps straight into the air, they activate their leg muscles.
¬ActivatesLegMuscles(yuri) ::: Yuri does not activate his leg muscles.

Conclusion:
Yuri ::: the individual named Yuri.
